adventures.title: The Door That Opens Tomorrow
adventures.subtitle: A ship due tomorrow sends a warning today.
adventures.blurb: A warning from tomorrow. Five endings. The routes you choose change what happens.

adventures.title: The Thirteenth Car
adventures.subtitle: Twelve cars on the list. Thirteen on the track.
adventures.blurb: A star train. A car nobody coupled. Something singing behind a door with no handle. Seven endings, and no two journeys the same.
